profile.name: 调试回显测试设备
profile.description: 一种通用的调试/占位测试设备，用于实验室自动化系统中的通信联调、流程验证和日志检查。它不对应明确的专用实验仪器功能，更适合在设备接入前或开发阶段验证初始化、关闭和控制链路是否正常。
profile.description_en: A generic debug and placeholder test device used in laboratory automation for communication checks, workflow validation, and logging verification. It does not clearly correspond to a specific lab instrument function, and is mainly suited for validating initialization, shutdown, and control pathways during development or system integration.

registry.name: Debug Echo
registry.description: Debug Echo Device是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括初始化。支持Signal, Slot, doShutdownDevice等操作。
